senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פָּשׁר) [to divide, spread,] to solve; to interpret.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55b:16">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>כ״ר פּוֹתְרֵי חלומות וכ׳</he> twenty-four interpreters of dreams existed in Jerusalem, <he>ומה שפ׳ לי זה לא פ׳ וכ׳</he> and not two of them interpreted my dream alike. Pesik. Par., p. 33ᵃ <he>פ׳ קרא בפרשת פרה</he> explained the verse (<cite ref="Psalms 12:7">Ps. XII, 7</cite>) as referring to the lesson concerning the red cow; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:2">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be interpreted, solved. Ber. l. c. חלום שנ׳ וכ׳ a dream which was interpreted in a dream. Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵇ תִּיפָּתֵר שפודין וכ׳ it may be explained that they redeem unblemished sacrifices, and when afterwards they are blemished, (the money paid for them is secularized). Y. Ber. VII, 11ᵃ bot. תיפתר כר׳ וכ׳ the difficulty may be solved in agreement with R. Ishmael’s opinion; a. fr.
